name: Dropdown menu
description: List of actions that opens from a button. Native popover + WAI-ARIA menu keyboard model (arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Esc/Tab), submenus and inline expandable sections.

classes.ayy-menu: On the element with popover and role="menu".
classes.ayy-menu--static: Static menu rendered inline in a page or window without popover behavior.
classes.ayy-menu__item--sub: Submenu parent row with an inline-end chevron.
classes.ayy-menu__item--expand: Inline accordion row that expands its items below itself.
classes.ayy-menu__item--described: Two-line row with an aligned label and soft description.
classes.ayy-menu__item-text: Text container for a described row's label and description.
classes.ayy-menu__description: Soft description text under a described row's label.
classes.ayy-menu__value: Muted text or badge before the chevron or shortcut.
classes.ayy-menu__chevron: Chevron icon pointing towards the inline end or down when expandable.
classes.ayy-menu__group--inline: Indented role="group" of items revealed by an expandable row.
classes.ayy-menu__shortcut: Keyboard shortcut hint at the end of an item.

default.looks: Raised surface panel with a line-strong border and the overlay shadow; items are transparent rows with muted icons.

pressed.none: Items have no pressed look: activating one runs it and closes the menu.

focus.looks: Focused item gets the wash-hover background; keyboard focus adds a 2px ring inset by 2px. Forced colours: Highlight fill.

disabled.looks: Item dims to --ayy-opacity-disabled with a not-allowed cursor; arrow keys skip it.

selected.looks: Semibold with a check at the inline end, drawn in currentColor. For view options in a menu (density, sort, show/hide columns); to choose a form value, use Select.

error.none: A menu has no error state; report a failed command with a toast.

loading.none: Build the items before opening; if they load, put the trigger Button in loading until they're ready.

open.looks: Fades in and scales up from 97%; parent rows keep the hover background while open.

sizes.density: Items are the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch) with control md text.
sizes.width: At least 11rem, at most 20rem (or the viewport minus 1rem); grows with its longest item.

js: menuItemClass({ destructive?, sub?, expand?, described?, className? }); menuClass, menuLabelClass, menuSeparatorClass, menuShortcutClass, menuValueClass, menuChevronClass, menuDescriptionClass, menuGroupInlineClass constants; connectMenu(trigger, content, { side?, align?, at?, boundary?, static?, subSide?, onSelect?, onToggle?, onSubmenuLayout? })

events.ayy-select: { value: string, item: HTMLElement } — value is the item's data-value, else its text
events.ayy-submenu-layout: { open: boolean, width: number, height: number, side: FloatingSide }

element.children: A trigger <button> and a [popover] element with role="menu" containing .ayy-menu__item buttons, optional submenu panels, and expandable groups.

react.import: import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem } from "@danitesler/ayywi/react";

props.onSelect: () => void — runs when chosen; the menu then closes unless closeOnSelect=false

a11y: Opening moves focus to the first item; arrows move, Home/End jump, letters jump to matching items.
ArrowRight / ArrowLeft open and close submenus (mirrored in RTL); Esc inside a submenu closes only that panel.
Esc or Tab closes the menu and focus returns to the trigger.
do: Use a menu for an item's secondary actions (rename, duplicate, delete) and for overflow “⋯” menus in toolbars and table rows.
Nest one level at most, for variants of one action. Don't hide frequent actions in a submenu.
Put destructive actions last, after a separator.
Keep item labels to a verb + noun: "Rename project".
dont: Don't use a menu to choose a value in a form — use Select or Radio.
Don't use a menu to navigate between pages — use links.
Don't put form fields or rich content in a menu — use Popover.
Don't nest submenus more than one level.
